**Job Description**
This practice is built for the way enterprise software
*actually*
gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses.
  
  
As an AI Engineer, you'll work directly with clients to shape, design and build those solutions. Working alongside Product Strategists and Data Engineers, you'll take products from discovery through deployment, combining technical depth with a practical understanding of what clients need to achieve. On some engagements, we continue to run what we've built, giving you the opportunity to stay close to the product and see the impact of your work long after go-live.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. Most of the code here is written by agents. That does not make this a supervision job. It moves the engineering upstream, where strong engineering judgment becomes even more important. You'll write code, review agent-generated outputs, and shape the architecture, controls and acceptance criteria that determine whether a solution succeeds in production. Requirements do not always arrive fully formed, and part of the role is helping define the problem while continuing to move delivery forward.
  
  
**As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to:**

* Architect the elements that determine whether AI solutions succeed in production, including tool selection, memory and context management, guardrail design, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Build and deploy the technical components that power agentic systems, including retrieval pipelines, MCP services and integrations, and the systems that connect AI capabilities to enterprise data and processes.
* Modernize platforms and applications around current business needs, rebuilding where necessary rather than simply moving legacy functionality onto newer technology.
* Design security and operational resilience into solutions from the start, including access controls, identity management, deployment guardrails, and oversight of automated actions.
* Break down complex problems into deliverable components, helping shape scope, sequencing, and implementation approaches that enable rapid delivery.
* Create reusable patterns, skills, and tooling that strengthen future engagements and contribute to the growth of the capability.

**Qualifications**
You have a track record of designing, building, and delivering complex technology solutions in production environments. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work.
  
  
**To be successful, you'll have:**

* Engineering foundations

+ Experience building and operating production software. Client-facing technical delivery experience is expected at senior levels.
+ Strong software engineering skills, ideally including Python and TypeScript.
+ Experience designing and delivering cloud-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

**Why Join Zelis?**
Healthcare is one of the most complex industries in the world—and one of the biggest opportunities for AI to create meaningful impact.
  
  
Zelis sits at the center of the healthcare financial ecosystem, connecting payers, providers, and millions of healthcare consumers. Every day, our technology helps simplify complex payment and pricing workflows, improve financial accuracy, and reduce administrative burden across the healthcare system.
  
  
We're building a new Agentic AI Engineering function to rethink how AI can solve some of healthcare's hardest operational challenges. This isn’t a traditional feature-development role. You’ll work directly with senior business leaders, engineers, and domain experts to identify high-value problems, determine where AI can create real leverage, and build solutions through production.
  
  
If you're energized by solving ambiguous problems, experimenting with the latest AI technologies, and seeing your work quickly reach production, you'll thrive here. As one of the first Agentic AI Engineers at Zelis, you'll help define how AI is applied across our business while shaping a brand-new engineering function.
  
  
****Position Overview****
As an Agentic AI Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of AI, software engineering, and business strategy to solve complex healthcare challenges. You'll own projects from discovery through launch and transition, partnering with internal business and technical teams to design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions that improve healthcare financial workflows. Success in this role requires curiosity, ownership, and the ability to turn complex problems into scalable solutions.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Partner with internal business leaders and engineers to identify high-value AI opportunities.
* Translate complex healthcare business problems into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Use the right tool for the problem. Apply AI where reasoning and ambiguity require it, while using deterministic software, rules, and controls where they provide greater reliability.
* Design, build, and deploy production-ready AI agents and applications.
* Build agent workflows, tool integrations, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration layers.
* Work directly with stakeholders through discovery, implementation, launch, and handoff.
* Improve automation, decision support, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
* Identify reusable agentic patterns that strengthen the core platform.
* Tackle ambiguous problems where there isn't an existing playbook.
* Validate outcomes, establish guardrails, and transition solutions to long-term owning teams.

****What You’ll Bring****

* Approximately 3–5 years building software or AI products in startups, applied AI, innovation, consulting, or similar fast-moving environments.
* Experience delivering production software or AI solutions from prototype through launch.
* Experience with LLMs, agents, RAG, tool use, APIs, or modern AI frameworks.
* Interest and experience partnering directly with internal business stakeholders or customers to understand complex problems, lead technical discussions, and translate needs into practical solutions.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in at least one modern programming language.
* Experience deploying cloud-based production systems.
* Ability to evaluate agent behavior, system performance, and appropriate AI guardrails.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and owning problems from discovery through handoff.
* Strong communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Evidence of curiosity and hands-on experimentation with AI—through your professional work, open source, personal projects, agents, automations, or other technical exploration.
* A builder mindset—we value curiosity, experimentation, and ownership as much as any specific technology stack.
* We care more about what you've built than where you've worked. If you're constantly experimenting with AI, building agents, and shipping projects, we'd love to connect.
